{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values (-1) for customer_age
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of valid age entries: {len(df_filtered)}")
print(f"Mean age of valid customers: {mean_age:.2f} years")"}
